shortDescription: This module allows setting up Kafka connectors from Ansible.

options.name: active_connectors
options.description: Dict of active connectors (each connector object must have a 'name' and a 'config' field)

options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication

options.name: connect_url
options.description: URL of the Connect REST server to use to add/edit connectors

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specify timeout while connecting to connect REST server

options.name: token
options.description: IDP token or MDS token used for Bearer Auth
